topic: Fibromyalgia: 2016 ACR diagnostic criteria, central sensitisation, non-pharmacological management

source.title: Evolving Concepts in the Diagnosis and Management of Fibromyalgia: A Moving Target
source.whyItFits: Open review of fibromyalgia diagnosis, including the move from tender points to the Widespread Pain Index and Symptom Severity Scale and the 2016 generalised-pain revision, plus first-line non-drug care and FDA-approved drugs. The stored NG117 bronchiectasis text is the wrong disease.
